name: io.github.meser10/meser10-mcp
description: Operate the Meser 10 email and SMS platform from any MCP client. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: MESER10_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key issued in the Meser 10 UI under My Account, Advanced settings, API settings.

environmentVariables.name: MESER10_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Meser 10 account number. Not a secret. Optional: 17 of the 61 operations authenticate on the key alone, the other 44 need it.

environmentVariables.name: MESER10_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Safety gate: read (default), write, send or destructive. Each level adds tools; send delivers to real recipients and spends credit.

environmentVariables.name: MESER10_MAX_RECIPIENTS
environmentVariables.description: Refuses any single send targeting more addresses than this cap.
